reason: Frozen160-coordinate interpolation does not recover omitted physical energy on accepted TRAIN16 capture.
decision: Positive source cost alone does not justify a model diagnostic when the frozen fit worsens unsampled local error and is3.31x worse than failed224 deletion.
scope: One current TRAIN16 L10 factor capture; not a claim that every interpolation algorithm or every network is impossible. Original PRD224 failure remains unchanged.
